roundsSummary: Round 1 (head 78f0acf1): failed on three text defects — the false 'du reports 0 blocks' parenthetical, the not-charged list calling two read-only Secret mounts in-memory directories, and an ungrammatical clause.

Round 2 (head 925cac4e): all three fixed and verified, but the replacement bullet named `df -x` as a one-filesystem flag to avoid (GNU df's -x is --exclude-type and takes an argument) and credited `du` with finding the 4.4 GiB of Go caches, which its cited record does not say.

Round 3 (head 9807862f, note at 04589b7a): both answered — `df -x` replaced by the measured caveat that df answers for the filesystem holding the path it is given, and the attribution deleted. Verified on the live surface; no failure stands.
